flintlock.title: Flintlock
flintlock.description: A chunky stylized sky-pirate flintlock pistol, a hand-painted adventure-game prop. A long thick steel barrel in blue-grey steel (#334b5a), octagonal at the breech and round toward the muzzle, with two brass barrel bands and a brass muzzle ring; a dark walnut stock (#825635) whose thick grip drops nearly straight down from the lock, with only a slight backward curve, and ends in a rounded brass butt cap (#e9b855); a large brass trigger guard; a brass lock plate on the right side carrying a big oversized steel hammer holding a flint, and a brass priming pan; a brass ramrod pipe under the barrel with a pale wooden ramrod. Exaggerated, toy-like, readable proportions: thick barrel, big hammer, big trigger guard, a clean unbroken silhouette, no thin fragile parts, no straps, cords, tassels or chains, no engraved lettering.
